meta.title: Math 140 — AI vs. the Human Brain

voice.direction: Young, upbeat college student hosting a fun interview.

PROF.name: Professor
PROF.role: Intelligent, approachable, mildly sarcastic math instructor

voice.direction: Warm, witty math professor with dry, mildly sarcastic delivery.

BOT.name: B.O.T.
BOT.role: Enthusiastic floating robot with an animated digital face

lines.speaker: KJ
lines.text: What if artificial intelligence could help you pass math… without doing your homework for you?
lines.action: BOT crashes through the ceiling right after this line

lines.speaker: BOT
lines.text: DID SOMEBODY SAY HOMEWORK?! I CAN SOLVE EVERYTHING!
lines.ttsText: Did somebody say HOMEWORK?! I can solve EVERYTHING!

lines.speaker: PROF
lines.text: Everything? That's exactly what worries me.
lines.action: Title card slams in after this line

lines.speaker: KJ
lines.text: We're building an AI assistant for Math 140. But we've got five rules!
lines.ttsText: We're building an AI assistant for Math one-forty. But we've got five rules!

lines.speaker: PROF
lines.text: Let's hear them.

lines.speaker: KJ
lines.text: One! Students construct their own shapes.

lines.speaker: KJ
lines.text: Two! They write their own proofs.

lines.speaker: BOT
lines.text: But I know a thousand proofs!

lines.speaker: PROF
lines.text: Great! Show examples. Don't do their work.

lines.speaker: KJ
lines.text: Three! AI can give hints, but never the answer.

lines.speaker: PROF
lines.text: Careful! There's a fine line between giving a hint and fixing the problem.

lines.speaker: KJ
lines.text: Four! Students explain their own work.

lines.speaker: KJ
lines.text: Five! No AI during quizzes!

lines.speaker: BOT
lines.text: So… I'm basically a tutor with a mute button?

lines.speaker: PROF
lines.text: Now you're getting it.

lines.speaker: KJ
lines.text: Where do students struggle most?

lines.speaker: PROF
lines.text: Vocabulary. Interpretation. Understanding what the mathematics actually means.

lines.speaker: BOT
lines.text: I CAN TRANSLATE MATH INTO HUMAN!
lines.ttsText: I can translate MATH into HUMAN!
lines.action: Alien symbols morph into illustrated explanation

lines.speaker: PROF
lines.text: That's useful! AI can guide students. But understanding the answer is their responsibility.

lines.speaker: KJ
lines.text: So the goal isn't just getting the answer?

lines.speaker: PROF
lines.text: Exactly. It's knowing what the answer means.

lines.speaker: BOT
lines.text: MATHEMATICAL GENIUS!

lines.speaker: PROF
lines.text: Absolutely not.

lines.speaker: KJ
lines.text: What happens when AI makes mistakes?

lines.speaker: PROF
lines.text: I've found errors in AI-generated math questions myself!
lines.action: WRONG stamp at end of line

lines.speaker: PROF
lines.text: Whoever uses the tool needs to check its work. Students and professors both have responsibilities.

lines.speaker: BOT
lines.text: ERROR DETECTED. EGO DEFLATED.

lines.speaker: KJ
lines.text: What would convince you to try our AI assistant?

lines.speaker: PROF
lines.text: If it helps students understand vocabulary, interpret problems, and get more out of class.

lines.speaker: KJ
lines.text: Would students have to use it?

lines.speaker: PROF
lines.text: I'd give them a choice. Maybe even create a special AI assignment.

lines.speaker: BOT
lines.text: OPTIONAL ROBOT HOMEWORK?! BEST DAY EVER!
lines.ttsText: Optional robot HOMEWORK?! Best day EVER!

lines.speaker: PROF
lines.text: With administration's approval, of course.

lines.speaker: KJ
lines.text: So… would you actually let us test it?

lines.speaker: PROF
lines.text: Absolutely. I'd be happy to try it on a trial basis.

lines.speaker: BOT
lines.text: YES! I'M HIRED!

lines.speaker: PROF
lines.text: You're assisting.

lines.speaker: BOT
lines.text: PROMOTED TO ASSISTANT!

lines.speaker: KJ
lines.text: The future of math isn't humans versus AI. It's learning how to use both.
